text: DECISION: finite-direction sliced Wasserstein returns Semimetric for every validated ProjectionDirections value; Semimetric promises only symmetry, non-negativity, and zero self-distance, not separation or triangle inequality. Projection count, KL probability floor, ScanMatch gap, and Sinkhorn regularisation/iterations/cell limit are parsed by opaque smart constructors before algorithm construction. Arbitrary ScanMatch substitution functions return generic Compare and are checked for finite non-negative costs with named operand indices; only the library-owned exact-match cost returns SymmetricCompare. The one-direction orthogonal-mass counterexample and compile-time Metric rejection remain in TrustRegressionSuite. Reusable semimetric laws run at 1, 2, 8, and 16 directions. Stronger Frame agreement also required WarpLaws to distinguish same-label specification conflicts from valid composition.
